titleEn: Royal Decree on Adjusting the Retirement Age of Female Civil Servants

articles.en: This Royal Decree sets out the adjustment of the retirement age of female civil servants.

- Female civil servants who have reached the age of 60 shall be placed on retirement in the following categories: - Category A: the category of registry officials, the category of registry officials of the Ministry of Interior, the category of foreign affairs registry officials, and the category of mid-level technical officials.
-- Category B: the category of administrative secretaries, and the category of administrative secretaries of the Ministry of Interior
; the category of prison guards of the Ministry of Interior, the category of primary health officials, and the category of primary [illegible] officials; - Category C: the category of administrative agents, the category of administrative agents of the Ministry of Interior, and the category of technical agents.

Female civil servants referred to in Article 2 above shall be entitled to retire before the age of 60 upon reaching the age of 55 or 58, according to their respective category, in compliance with the Royal Decree on the separate statute of each category.
Any provisions contrary to this Royal Decree shall be considered null and void.

Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen, Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Cambodia, shall be responsible for implementing this Royal Decree from the date of signature onwards; done at the Royal Palace, [day illegible] September 2012.
Royal signature and seal, Norodom Sihamoni, having respectfully submitted to the King for signature; Prime Minister, signature, Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen; submitted for the signature of Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen, Prime Minister; Secretary of State of the Secretariat of Civil Service, signature, Pech Bunthin; No. 34 Ch.L.; Phnom Penh 2012.
